Summary
Scalable, production-grade AI systems have been engineered
with a strong focus on RAG optimization, agentic workflows, and
knowledge-graph-powered retrieval. Recall in a Retrieval-Augmented
Generation pipeline was improved from 31.6% to 89.4% through
systematic embedding evaluation and metadata redesign, while
LLM operational costs were reduced by 83% by overcoming context-
window limitations and restructuring workflows 
. Agent-based HR voice assistants, SQL-aware copilots, and audio-
verification pipelines were architected using Python and modern LLM
tooling, consistently translating complex AI ideas into measurable,
high-impact, and cost-efficient systems.
Experience
.Kreate
Trainee - artificial intelligence
January 2026 - Present (8 months)
Hyderabad, Telangana, India
• Implemented RLVR-inspired verifier-based learning in an API-driven agentic
architecture by introducing dynamic few-shot prompting with Chain-of-
Thought reasoning and a reasoning memory layer that stores and reuses
validated outputs, improving accuracy from 76% to 94% on benchmark queries
while eliminating the need for model fine-tuning and establishing a scalable
feedback-driven optimization approach.
• Evaluated native agentic workflows against knowledge graph (KG)-integrated
architectures across 300 utterances and 20 business objects, identifying six
critical agent-level issues and resolving failure cases to improve accuracy
on previously failing tasks and enhance overall user experience in a single
iteration.
Renan

AI engineer
July 2025 - December 2025 (6 months)
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
• Optimized RAG retrieval quality by evaluating embedding models, defining
metadata strategies, and identifying pipeline bottlenecks — improving recall
from 31.6% → 89.4%
• Built a SQL autocompletion system (Cursor-style) where users attach
databases and receive context-aware SQL suggestions based on cursor
position, query history, and schema context — improving query accuracy and
usability
• Contributed to a conversational HR voice assistant, built using Python,
LiveKit RTC, AssemblyAI STT, ElevenLabs TTS, FAISS retrieval, and
LlamaIndex — enabling agent-based workflows for use-cases like job-
applications and onboarding across multi-tenant environments
• Developed an evaluation pipeline for annotators on the DataBrewery
platform, including multilingual script-reading assessment to ensure quality
labeling and onboarding
• Built a speech fingerprint verification pipeline to validate user consent audio
and detect duplicate submissions across accounts — improving platform
safety & compliance

Gurugram, Haryana, India

• Designed a pipeline to overcome context-window limits, enabling accurate
JSON-structured outputs while using Neo4j as a knowledge graph for reliable
retrieval & reasoning
• Reduced operational cost and token usage by ~83% by restructuring the
pipeline and improving retrieval + prompt strategy

• Built a multilingual conversational assistant using Gemini, adding real-time
